title: Eaton Q2 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At June 30, 2026 Eaton reported USD 483 million cash, USD 212 million short-term investments, USD 2.091 billion short-term debt and USD 18.509 billion long-term debt.
summary: The Q2 Form 10-Q provides current revenue, earnings, diluted share count, cash flow, working capital, debt, acquisition, segment and risk evidence for the scenario-complete Eaton assessment.
